addons.name: Single-disc
addons.blurb: Play the whole game from one Disc 1 image on CSR. v0.2.12: re-diffed after reverting the CSR v0.14.2 disc3.layer.json field 768 (LASTMAP) edit that skipped the AD3 script 31 PlayMovie/FMUSC opcodes -- both are now restored intact, matching CSR's own layer. Retains the v0.2.10 break-scene (LOST2) and v0.2.8/v0.2.9 D1->D2 transition (BLACKBGB) fixes. Ending/credits movies are re-enabled for playtesting; manip movies remain disabled pending re-validation on this new base.
addons.hint: CSR. Ending movies included; manip movies not yet re-enabled.
addons.betaNote: v0.2.12: single-disc's safe-field merge pulls FIELD/LAS4_2.DAT, LAS4_3.DAT, LAS4_4.DAT, and LASTMAP.DAT wholesale from CSR Disc 3 (they're D3-only edits vs pristine on D1/D2). CSR's disc3.layer.json (commit 965d040) now restores the original PlayMovie/FMUSC opcodes on field 768 (LASTMAP, AD3 script 31) that were previously routed around by a goto/label skip -- this addon layer was re-diffed against that updated CSR source so the fix flows through. Rebuilt in one pass via build_work_bin.py (all field merges + verified BLACKBGB manual splice + SNOVA inject + FIELD.BIN/WORLD.BIN table fix) and re-diffed against the CSR v0.14.2 D1 base. Not yet playtested past the Disc 3 ending sequence on DuckStation -- please playtest a full run through the ending. Manip movies and endings are currently disabled while this core is playtested standalone.

addons.name: CSR manip movies
addons.blurb: D2/D3 manip FMVs on D1 (delta pack, applies after manip-movies v0.1.4). v0.1.5 restores NRCRLB/NRCRL/PARASHOT/METEOFIX/METEOSKY D2 FMV injects (MD8_5, MD8_52, FSHIP_12) lost after v0.1.4. Fixes D1->D2 disc-swap hang caused by MD8_52's PMVIE/MOVIE call having no injected movie.
addons.hint: Hidden. Auto with Single-disc on CSR when CSR+ off.
